title: Nutty Australian Tagliatelle Pasta
description: A crumbly and nutty twist on traditional pasta, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Cook the tagliatelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the walnut oil over medium heat.
Add the almonds and hazelnuts to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Remove the nuts from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute or until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked tagliatelle pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the garlic and lemon juice mixture.
Return the toasted nuts to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with chopped parsley and parmesan cheese.
